label: shared read
detail: New bytes from the stored offset, at most 8 MiB a step.

label: byte chunks
detail: Chunks may split anywhere; a half-written line waits.

label: idempotent
detail: Insert-or-ignore on session and sequence number: the same bytes twice change nothing.

label: same commit
detail: Offset and entry count move in the same transaction.

label: resume offset
detail: On start, reading resumes from the stored offset.

label: after commit
detail: A parse error or panic is recorded as a failed run; capture continues.

label: retry, max 20
detail: A transient file error re-attaches and retries, up to 20 times in a row.
